newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian troops to help counter Naples crime wave.
newsitem.headline: Italian troops to help counter Naples crime wave.

text.p: Italy's cabinet on Friday approved the deployment of 500 soldiers to the southern port city of Naples to help counter a wave of mob violence that has swept the area since the beginning of the year.

The troops will take over certain guard duties in and around the city so that regular police officers will be free to focus on fighting the Naples Mafia, known as the Camorra, Interior Minister Giorgio Napolitano said.
The starting date and length of the deployment still need to be decided, Napolitano said.
Some 85 people have been killed and dozens injured over the past six months as Camorra gangs have been waging a war for supremacy in the streets of the city.
